answerBlocks.title: What SolCrys measures
answerBlocks.body: SolCrys tracks how often your brand is mentioned, cited, compared, and recommended when buyers ask AI engines category and product questions.

answerBlocks.title: Why it matters
answerBlocks.body: AI assistants increasingly answer before users click. If your brand is missing, misrepresented, or uncited, demand is shaped before your site gets a visit.

answerBlocks.title: How teams act
answerBlocks.body: Marketing teams use SolCrys to find weak answer coverage, publish authoritative pages, refresh claims, and close citation gaps against competitors.

faqs.question: What is Answer Engine Optimization?
faqs.answer: Answer Engine Optimization, or AEO, is the practice of making a brand's expertise, products, and proof easy for AI systems and search engines to retrieve, understand, cite, and summarize accurately.

faqs.question: How is AEO different from SEO?
faqs.answer: SEO focuses on visibility in search result pages. AEO focuses on whether AI answer engines can use your content as a reliable source inside generated answers, comparisons, and recommendations.

faqs.question: Which AI surfaces should brands monitor?
faqs.answer: Most brands should start with ChatGPT search, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude search, and any vertical AI assistant relevant to their category.

faqs.question: Does SolCrys replace existing SEO work?
faqs.answer: No. Strong technical SEO, useful content, crawlability, and authority are still the foundation. SolCrys extends that work into prompt-level AI visibility, citation readiness, and answer accuracy.

resourcePages.title: Answer Engine Optimization
resourcePages.metaTitle: Answer Engine Optimization: How Brands Win AI Discovery | SolCrys AI
resourcePages.description: Learn what Answer Engine Optimization is, why it matters, and how brands can structure content to be cited accurately by AI answer engines.
resourcePages.h1: Answer Engine Optimization: how brands become usable sources for AI answers
resourcePages.summary: AEO is not a replacement for SEO. It is an operating layer that makes your brand easier for AI systems to retrieve, verify, cite, and summarize when users ask high-intent questions.

sections.heading: Direct answer
body: Answer Engine Optimization is the practice of shaping your public web presence so AI answer engines can accurately retrieve your information, identify your expertise, cite your pages, and represent your brand in generated responses.

sections.heading: What AEO changes
body: Traditional SEO assumes a user scans a results page and chooses a link. AEO assumes an AI system may synthesize an answer first, using only the clearest and most trustworthy sources it can retrieve.
That changes the content job. Each important page must make the entity, answer, evidence, and next step obvious without relying on clever copy, hidden context, or JavaScript-only rendering.
bullets: Make the entity clear: product, company, category, audience, and use case.
Answer the question in the first screen, then support it with evidence.
Use headings, tables, FAQs, and schema to reduce ambiguity.
Keep claims current and easy to verify.

sections.heading: A practical AEO workflow
body: Start by building a prompt set around buyer questions, category comparisons, alternatives, risks, and implementation concerns. Measure how often the brand is mentioned and cited. Then map each weak answer pattern to a page that can become the strongest source for that topic.
bullets: Audit prompts across major answer engines.
Group prompts by intent and buying stage.
Identify missing citations, wrong facts, and weak comparisons.
Publish or refresh pages that answer those prompts directly.
Re-measure citation and answer accuracy after indexing.

faqs.question: Is AEO the same as GEO?
faqs.answer: They overlap. AEO is usually framed around answers and snippets, while GEO, or Generative Engine Optimization, is framed around generative AI retrieval, grounding, citations, and summaries.

faqs.question: Can schema alone improve AI visibility?
faqs.answer: No. Schema helps classify content, but AI visibility also depends on crawlability, clear text, topical depth, evidence, authority, and whether the page actually answers the user's question.

faqs.question: What is the first AEO metric to track?
faqs.answer: Start with citation rate and answer accuracy for a fixed set of high-intent prompts. Rankings alone do not show whether AI systems are using your brand as a source.

resourcePages.title: AEO vs SEO
resourcePages.metaTitle: AEO vs SEO: What Changes in AI Search | SolCrys AI
resourcePages.description: Compare SEO and Answer Engine Optimization, including goals, content formats, measurement, and the role of technical SEO in AI discovery.
resourcePages.h1: AEO vs SEO: what changes when answers replace result pages
resourcePages.summary: SEO is still required, but it is no longer sufficient for brands that want to be cited in AI-generated answers.

sections.heading: Direct answer
body: SEO helps pages rank in search results. AEO helps content become a reliable source inside AI-generated answers, recommendations, and comparisons.

sections.heading: Comparison
body: The strongest programs treat SEO and AEO as one system: crawlable pages, helpful content, structured data, authority signals, and prompt-level measurement.

rows: Citation rate, mention quality, answer accuracy
Pages with direct answers, evidence, tables, FAQs, and definitions

sections.heading: Why SEO remains the foundation
body: AI answer engines still depend on discoverable, crawlable, authoritative web content. If a page is blocked, thin, slow, or ambiguous, it is less likely to become a useful source for generated answers.
bullets: Technical SEO makes pages discoverable.
Content depth gives systems usable evidence.
Internal links clarify topical relationships.
Freshness reduces the chance of outdated answers.

faqs.question: Should a brand create separate AEO pages?
faqs.answer: Only when the page answers a real question better than an existing page. AEO rewards clarity and usefulness, not duplicated pages with new labels.

faqs.question: Do AI answer engines use keywords?
faqs.answer: They use queries and retrieval systems, but matching is more semantic. Use the words customers use, then answer the underlying intent completely.

resourcePages.title: AI Brand Visibility Monitoring
resourcePages.metaTitle: AI Brand Visibility Monitoring for Answer Engines | SolCrys AI
resourcePages.description: A practical guide to measuring brand mentions, citations, sentiment, and competitive position across AI answer engines.
resourcePages.h1: AI brand visibility monitoring: know where your brand appears in AI answers
resourcePages.summary: AI brand visibility monitoring measures whether AI systems mention, cite, recommend, compare, or misrepresent your brand when buyers ask relevant questions.

sections.heading: Direct answer
body: AI brand visibility monitoring tracks your brand's presence and accuracy across AI answer engines, including mentions, citations, share of voice, sentiment, and hallucination risk.

sections.heading: Signals to measure
body: A useful monitoring system must capture more than whether the brand appears. It must show why the answer appeared, which source was cited, and whether the answer helps or hurts conversion.
bullets: Mention presence: whether the brand appears in the answer.
Citation presence: whether the brand's own pages are linked as a source.
Position and framing: how the brand is described relative to competitors.
Accuracy: whether features, pricing, claims, and category fit are correct.
Sentiment: whether the generated answer is positive, neutral, or negative.

sections.heading: How to build a prompt set
body: The prompt set should mirror real buyer behavior. Include broad category prompts, comparison prompts, alternatives prompts, risk prompts, implementation prompts, and post-purchase support prompts.

faqs.question: How often should AI brand visibility be measured?
faqs.answer: Measure high-value prompts weekly at minimum. For launches, crises, or fast-moving categories, daily monitoring gives a better early-warning system.

faqs.question: Is citation more important than mention?
faqs.answer: Both matter. Mentions show brand awareness inside answers; citations show that the AI system is using your own content as evidence.

resourcePages.title: ChatGPT Brand Mentions
resourcePages.metaTitle: How to Monitor ChatGPT Brand Mentions | SolCrys AI
resourcePages.description: Learn how to monitor whether ChatGPT mentions, cites, or misrepresents a brand across high-intent customer prompts.
resourcePages.h1: How to monitor ChatGPT brand mentions and citations
resourcePages.summary: Monitoring ChatGPT brand mentions requires a repeatable prompt set, consistent timing, answer capture, source capture, and review of accuracy and recommendation quality.

sections.heading: Direct answer
body: To monitor ChatGPT brand mentions, run a fixed set of category, comparison, and buyer-intent prompts on a schedule, record whether your brand appears, capture cited sources, and score the answer for accuracy and sentiment.

sections.heading: Prompt types to include
body: A brand should not only test its name. The most useful prompts often do not mention the brand at all; they ask for solutions, alternatives, comparisons, and recommendations.
bullets: Best tools for a specific job-to-be-done.
Alternatives to a known competitor.
Category comparisons and buying criteria.
Implementation, security, and integration questions.
Brand-specific accuracy checks.

sections.heading: What to do with the results
body: Treat each missing or inaccurate answer as a content brief. The fix may be a clearer category page, a comparison page, a product FAQ, a stronger About page, or a factual correction in public documentation.

faqs.question: Can a brand force ChatGPT to cite its site?
faqs.answer: No. The practical path is to make pages crawlable, authoritative, specific, and useful enough to be selected as supporting sources.

faqs.question: Should monitoring include prompts that mention competitors?
faqs.answer: Yes. Competitor and alternative prompts reveal whether the market narrative is being shaped before a buyer reaches your site.

resourcePages.title: AI Search Share of Voice
resourcePages.metaTitle: AI Search Share of Voice: Measurement Framework | SolCrys AI
resourcePages.description: Measure how often a brand appears versus competitors in AI-generated answers, citations, and recommendations.
resourcePages.h1: AI search share of voice: measure who owns the answer
resourcePages.summary: AI search share of voice measures how often a brand appears, is cited, and is recommended compared with competitors across a defined prompt set.

sections.heading: Direct answer
body: AI search share of voice is the percentage of relevant AI-generated answers in which a brand is mentioned, cited, or recommended relative to competitors.

sections.heading: Recommended scoring model
body: A useful score separates weak visibility from useful visibility. A brand mention in a negative comparison is not the same as a cited recommendation.

rows: Was the brand included in the answer?
Was the brand recommended for the use case?
Was the brand first, middle, or last?

sections.heading: How to interpret movement
body: A rising mention score without citations may mean the brand is known but lacks useful owned sources. A rising citation score often means the content library is becoming more retrievable and useful.

faqs.question: What is a good AI share of voice benchmark?
faqs.answer: There is no universal benchmark. Compare against your top competitors within the same prompt set and category over time.

faqs.question: Should citations and mentions be weighted equally?
faqs.answer: Usually no. Citations often deserve more weight because they show the engine is using your content as evidence, not merely naming the brand.

resourcePages.title: AI Hallucination Risk Monitoring
resourcePages.metaTitle: AI Hallucination Risk Monitoring for Brands | SolCrys AI
resourcePages.description: Monitor and reduce the risk that AI answer engines publish inaccurate, outdated, or harmful information about a brand.
resourcePages.h1: AI hallucination risk monitoring: protect the facts AI repeats about your brand
resourcePages.summary: AI hallucination risk monitoring finds inaccurate or unsupported AI statements about your brand and maps them to corrective content, source, and reputation actions.

sections.heading: Direct answer
body: AI hallucination risk monitoring is the process of detecting, classifying, and correcting inaccurate AI-generated claims about a brand, product, leadership team, pricing, policies, or market position.

sections.heading: Common brand risks
body: Brand risk usually starts with ambiguity. If public sources disagree or important facts are missing, AI systems may fill gaps with outdated or inferred statements.
bullets: Incorrect product capabilities or integrations.
Outdated pricing, availability, or market focus.
Wrong founder, leadership, or company details.
Confusing the brand with similarly named companies.
Unsupported claims repeated from low-quality sources.

sections.heading: Corrective actions
body: The fastest fixes are usually source fixes: clarify the official page, add an FAQ, improve schema, update third-party profiles, and make canonical facts consistent across the web.

faqs.question: Can hallucination risk be eliminated?
faqs.answer: No. It can be reduced by making official information clearer, more consistent, more crawlable, and easier to cite.

faqs.question: Which facts should be monitored first?
faqs.answer: Start with facts that affect trust and conversion: what the product does, who it is for, pricing and availability, security claims, leadership, and competitor comparisons.
